name: facebookresearch_moco-v3/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_moco-v3/main_lincls.py.run_linear_classification_training: run linear classification training on ImageNet using a MoCo pretrained checkpoint with cosine LR decay

facebookresearch_moco-v3/main_lincls.py.run_distributed_training: run distributed multi-GPU linear classification training using PyTorch DDP with NCCL backend
facebookresearch_moco-v3/main_lincls.py.resume_checkpoint_training: resume linear classifier training from a saved checkpoint file and continue from the last epoch
facebookresearch_moco-v3/main_lincls.py.run_sanity_check: run a sanity check to verify frozen backbone weights were not modified during linear classifier training

facebookresearch_moco-v3/main_moco.py.run_moco_pretraining: run MoCo self-supervised pre-training on ImageNet with distributed data parallel across multiple GPUs
facebookresearch_moco-v3/main_moco.py.run_moco_vit_pretraining: run MoCo pre-training using ViT architecture with configurable stop-grad on first conv layer
facebookresearch_moco-v3/main_moco.py.resume_moco_checkpoint: resume MoCo training from a saved checkpoint file with optimizer and scaler state
facebookresearch_moco-v3/main_moco.py.adjust_learning_rate_cosine: adjust the optimizer learning rate using a warmup then half-cycle cosine decay schedule
facebookresearch_moco-v3/main_moco.py.adjust_moco_momentum_cosine: adjust the MoCo momentum encoder update coefficient with a half-cycle cosine schedule

facebookresearch_moco-v3/vits.py.build_vit_small_model: build a ViT-Small MoCo model with 384-dim embeddings and 12 transformer blocks
facebookresearch_moco-v3/vits.py.build_vit_base_model: build a ViT-Base MoCo model with 768-dim embeddings and 12 transformer blocks
facebookresearch_moco-v3/vits.py.build_vit_conv_small_model: build a ViT-Small model using ConvStem embedding layer instead of patch embedding
facebookresearch_moco-v3/vits.py.build_vit_conv_base_model: build a ViT-Base model using ConvStem embedding layer instead of patch embedding
facebookresearch_moco-v3/vits.py.review_VisionTransformerMoCo_class: review the VisionTransformerMoCo class and its 2D sin-cos position embedding initialization
